items.title: Pay doctor's invoice
items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum unter Angabe der Rechnungsnummer.
items.computation: This is a private invoice (not from an authority), so no deemed-delivery rule applies; the period runs from the invoice date itself. Start: invoice dated Fri 26.06.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (26.06.2026) is not counted, so counting starts 27.06.2026. 30 days later (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) falls on Sun 26.07.2026. Since that is a Sunday, § 193 BGB shifts the deadline to the next business day, Mon 27.07.2026. Holidays of Hamburg (practice's seat) checked, none intervene.

warnings: This is a private doctor's bill (GOÄ) and can be submitted to a private health insurer for reimbursement; it is not an authority letter, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies to it.

The IBAN on the invoice (DE53 3705 0198 0006 5544 30) is well-formed and matches a German bank, but a valid IBAN does not prove the account belongs to this practice; compare it with a prior, independently-verified invoice before paying.
